cohort: Singleton cephalic term deliveries in British Columbia from 2004 to 2020
finding: While persistent occiput posterior deliveries have higher rates of adverse outcomes compared to those rotating to occiput anterior, among persistent occiput posterior deliveries, spontaneous vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery have the lowest frequency of adverse outcomes, while forceps deliveries have the highest.
mod_finding: Among persistent occiput posterior deliveries, spontaneous vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery had the lowest frequency of adverse outcomes, whereas forceps deliveries had the highest.
